# How to Excel to PDF with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to convert an excel (.xlsx) file to pdf, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_excel_to_pdf`

## Prompt

```text
Convert an Excel (.xlsx) file to PDF.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input Excel file id.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: excel-to-pdf-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
